findings.title: Housekeeping runs card recovery unguarded, ahead of the expiry sweep
findings.detail: housekeeping_once now runs ctx.card_recover() before state_machine.sweep_expired() and prune_retention(). CardPublisher.recover -> _card_sent renders cards and does not catch errors, so one row whose render raises makes every tick stop before the sweep, and AWAITING_APPROVAL contributions stop expiring. Wrap card_recover in its own try/except (log card_recover_failed), or run it last.

findings.title: Draft hold-back only holds for patterns with a bounded match width
findings.detail: BA-16 refuses patterns by minimum width. A whitespace-free extra_patterns entry with a small minimum and a maximum of 256 or more (e.g. x[a-z]{1,1000}y) passes the load refusals, and draft_visible shows its first len-256 characters before the match completes. The code follows the spec, so this is design-level: raise it at the Phase 2 gate, or also refuse a max width >= HOLD_BACK (a DESIGN change, ask first per hard rule 12).

findings.title: squid_drift reports no drift indefinitely for a snapshot the schema rejects
findings.detail: When parse_bundle raises ConfigError for the snapshot the live conf names, squid_drift returns [] with no time or state bound. That fixes the recorded redeploy incident, but it is fail-open in an egress guard. Limit it to the case where that snapshot is not the current one (and/or a time window), or report a WARN in doctor.

findings.title: squid_drift takes the Hermes login-window state from the conf under test
findings.detail: The expected render uses hermes_login='\nacl cat_kiro_idc_login ' in text, so a conf left with the IdC login window open is never drift. Compare it against the real window state when FEAT-007 adds the window.

findings.title: No test of /kill during a slow Confirm preflight
findings.detail: The item 25 test list asks for typed /kill while a slow preflight is held open. D14 allows a wait of up to 8 s there, but no test bounds it. Add a case that /kill sent during a preflight is handled within PREFLIGHT_TIMEOUT_S plus the handler budget.
